Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Would it be possible to add the following feature: see the upcoming events as a list (with or without filters).

The purpose is to have an exhaustive view of all the events to come in a more convenient way. "Oh, there's a tournament near the border in Germany, maybe I could go there."

Currently, there is a lot of space lost in the calendar view (because most tournaments occur during the week-end), it's limited to one month (you have to scroll to the next page), there's not all the data visible (you have to click on it) and you can't reasonably print it to make a trip plan.

It shouldn't be a lot of work since the data are already there, it just the way they're shown.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
I will make an upcoming events list for the front page, a bit like the one that was on WW's site, once I get the time for it. But I guess getting events reported and players registered goes a notch over in priority.
